title: The counit of Lf^*(- ⊗^L -)
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring] and $f\colon X\to Y$ a morphism of schemes. Write $\Mod_{\Lambda_T}$ for module objects over the pulled-back ring on the pro-étale site of $T$, $f^*$ for the (exact, monoidal) pullback of module objects, $Lf^*$ for its left derived functor and $\otimes^L$ for the derived tensor product [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull, sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom]; $Q_h\colon K(\Mod_{\Lambda_T})\to D(\Mod_{\Lambda_T})$ is the localization of the homotopy category. The maps $Lf^*(Q_hA\otimes^LQ_hB)\to Lf^*Q_h(A\otimes B)\to Q_h(f^*(A\otimes B))$, $Lf^*$ of the lax structure of $Q_h$ followed by the counit of the derived pullback, form a natural transformation of bifunctors on $K(\Mod_{\Lambda_Y})$.

proof.text: Apply the derived pullback functor to naturality of the lax localization tensorator. Compose with naturality of the derived counit at A tensor psi, respectively phi tensor B. Functoriality of the derived pullback and associativity give exactly the two naturality fields of the prescribed pointwise transformation. The Lean proof performs these two calculations in private lemmas for arbitrary Q, L and a natural transformation Q ⋙ L ⟶ T, then specializes them to Qh, Lf* and the derived pullback counit. No construction data changes.

lean.statement:
noncomputable def leftDerivedUpperStarTensorLeftCounit :
    (((whiskeringLeft₂ _).obj DerivedCategory.Qh).obj DerivedCategory.Qh).obj
        (leftDerivedUpperStarTensorLeft Λ f) ⟶
      upperStarTensorTarget Λ f where
  app A :=
    { app B := L((f)^*⟦Λ⟧).map (Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ DerivedCategory.Qh A B) ≫
        (f)^*⟦Λ⟧.leftDerivedFunctorCounit.app (A ⊗ B)
      naturality B B' ψ := by
        have h₁ := Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ_natural_right DerivedCategory.Qh A ψ
        have h₂ := (f)^*⟦Λ⟧.leftDerivedFunctorCounit.naturality (A ◁ ψ)
        dsimp only [Functor.comp_map] at h₂
        change L((f)^*⟦Λ⟧).map (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj A ◁ DerivedCategory.Qh.map ψ) ≫
            L((f)^*⟦Λ⟧).map (Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ DerivedCategory.Qh A B') ≫ _ =
          (L((f)^*⟦Λ⟧).map (Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ DerivedCategory.Qh A B) ≫ _) ≫
            DerivedCategory.Qh.map (((f)^*⟦Λ⟧.mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map (A ◁ ψ))
        rw [← Functor.map_comp_assoc, h₁, Functor.map_comp_assoc, Category.assoc, h₂] }
  naturality A A' φ := by
    ext B
    have h₁ := Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ_natural_left DerivedCategory.Qh φ B
    have h₂ := (f)^*⟦Λ⟧.leftDerivedFunctorCounit.naturality (φ ▷ B)
    dsimp only [Functor.comp_map] at h₂
    change L((f)^*⟦Λ⟧).map (DerivedCategory.Qh.map φ ▷ DerivedCategory.Qh.obj B) ≫
        L((f)^*⟦Λ⟧).map (Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ DerivedCategory.Qh A' B) ≫ _ =
      (L((f)^*⟦Λ⟧).map (Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ DerivedCategory.Qh A B) ≫ _) ≫
        DerivedCategory.Qh.map (((f)^*⟦Λ⟧.mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map (φ ▷ B))
    rw [← Functor.map_comp_assoc, h₁, Functor.map_comp_assoc, Category.assoc, h₂]
